proposed_limits.cost_interpretation: Claude: eight writer slots at $5 plus $0.05 canary, total $40.05 list-equivalent cap. Codex subscription:24 pair attempts at15min plus1 canary at5min; no enforceable USD/token ceiling, record actual tokens/account usage. Eight built-in reviewer sessions plus1 H-coder session separately counted; no asserted dollar debit. No API billing switch.
proposed_limits.maximum_total_attempts_meaning: 34 CLI invocations plus8 built-in review sessions plus1 built-in coding session; unlike CLI attempts a session may have multiple tool interactions.

retry_policy.runtime_critic: Existing one automatic retry per question/order operation only for invalid response or call failure; retain aggregate attempt counts/errors and successful structured judgments. Invalid raw response text is not retained.
retry_policy.manual: No fresh-session retry; staged tool reads within the same built-in session are permitted.
retry_policy.exhaustion: Stop; preserve missing and failed slots/pairs. No discretionary rerun.

stop_rules: Any writer input leak, forbidden network use, changed data/prompt/skill tree, or unexplained requested/actual model mismatch or changed requested effort stops all new calls.
Before each operation check the explicitly approved resource contract and reserve its allowed calls/time; do not claim hard dollar/token enforcement where the adapter has none.
Any missing required token or requested-effort provenance pauses new calls until reconciled; expected Codex USD null is disclosed, not a missing-cost error or zero resource cost.
Any canary or renderer failure stops launch; no weakened canary.
Writer timeout/cap/invalid artifact occupies its slot; keep failure and scheduled pair denominator. No replacement writer.
Retry exhaustion stops the current operation; preserve partial results and prevent automatic whole-pair retry.
No live editing of stories/skills in response to interim outcomes.

manual_analysis.h2_primary_chart: First embedded chart explicitly supporting the lede comparison; identify from prose before any chart codes. If none, mark no eligible chart and unassessable with reason.
manual_analysis.h3_primary_relationship: First relationship between distinct material findings stated or implied in narrative order; identify before assigning H3 codes. If none, link-left-to-reader unless story has only one self-contained finding, then unassessable.
manual_analysis.unassessable: Retain in all scheduled denominators; no ordinal direction when either output unassessable.

critic_isolation_limit.codex_canary_meaning: The existing Codex canary passes its documented detection-based recipe even though repository/home/shared-temp reads may be possible. It does not establish filesystem denial.
critic_isolation_limit.critic_surface: Codex critic starts with temporary home/read-only workspace and masked prompt, but can potentially read outside supplied packet. Its adapter does not retain/scan full transcript, so external-read detection and fully verified context isolation cannot be claimed.
critic_isolation_limit.disposition: Accept before outputs as exploratory limitation; use explicit fixed-model masked questions/AB/BA contexts with no treatment labels or external-reading instruction. Report runtime critique separately from independent staged manual readings. Do not describe judge isolation as proven or interpret results as calibrated causal proof.
critic_isolation_limit.manual_surface: Built-in manual reviewers receive fresh contexts and progressive allowlisted packets; instruction-level blinding is recorded, not a filesystem enforcement claim.
